def char_indices(s, ch):
    return [i for i, c in enumerate(s) if c == ch]

def duplicate_each_char(s):
    return ''.join(c * 2 for c in s)

def remove_every_other_char(s):
    return s[::2]

def count_words_with_only_letters(s):
    return sum(1 for w in s.split() if w.isalpha())

def count_special_characters(s):
    return sum(1 for c in s if not c.isalnum() and not c.isspace())
